title: 游戏成实业增长“引擎”，2026腾讯游戏人生大会释放三大增长信号
text:
10月15日，“助力实业 创·享新机遇”2026腾讯游戏人生全球合作伙伴大会以线上直播的形式成功举办。
基于“助力实业 创·享新机遇”这一主题，腾讯游戏人生从出海打开增量、AI 提升效率、场景能力升级三大维度出发，围绕场景营销合作、大众赛事服务、网吧经营增长、品牌出海探索、AI 能力升级等方面，打造了一系列新产品、新能力与新资源政策，并将这些创新成果开放共享给全球合作伙伴，助力各行各业以更低门槛共享增长新机遇。
腾讯游戏副总裁高莉在开场致辞中表示：“腾讯游戏非常期待和全球范围内的合作伙伴，一起探索更多的新模式和更多的新可能，共同打造更多有意思、有意义的营销范例，用我们丰富生动的内容，为用户带来更加优质的体验。”
Table of Contents
海外游戏IP打头阵，助力企业“就地获客”
AI全流程贯穿，让合作更高效、省心
四大场景升级，解决五大诉求
结语
海外游戏IP打头阵，助力企业“就地获客”
越来越多中国企业把生意做到海外，海外本土品牌也希望抓住年轻人，但共同的难题是：产品出去了，本地化的获客抓手还没有跟上。
为补上这块短板，腾讯游戏人生把海外游戏IP转化为商户营销、电竞赛事、网吧合作的本地化服务，让游戏成为品牌在当地的获客入口。目前，腾讯游戏正以《PUBG MOBILE》、《三角洲行动》、《HONOR OF KINGS》等全球热门内容，开展商户营销、游戏特权、电竞赛事等多模块业务，为伙伴开拓海外市场提供助力。
这份助力的底气，来自腾讯游戏不断扩大的全球影响力。据腾讯游戏整合品牌负责人罗一航分享，第二季度腾讯游戏国际市场收入186亿元，按固定汇率同比增长4%；上半年自研游戏海外收入123.72亿美元，同比增长30.22%；在韩国，网吧也因《PUBG》、《三角洲行动》等游戏明显扩大了市场份额。在他看来，IP的影响力越大，联名的价值也越大。
全球影响力已具备，海外落地“水土不服”问题同样亟待解决。目前，商户合作平台、电竞合作平台、网吧合作平台已全面开放海外游戏合作，可按合作伙伴的海外经营模式结合游戏功能定制，帮助品牌快速提升当地影响力和获客能力。
具体打法已在东南亚跑通，目前腾讯游戏人生平台已全面开放《PUBG MOBILE》、《三角洲行动》、《HONOR OF KINGS》等海外IP的场景营销与电竞赛事合作，其中《HONOR OF KINGS》在东南亚各地区近一年的商户合作成效显著，获得中国出海企业与本土企业认可。针对海外用户习惯与商业环境的差异，平台沉淀出三步落地法：基于当地实体经营数字化能力发放核销券、以Coser打卡等定制内容聚客、端内商户赛与营销发券及实体经营合作模块化推进。
在赛事与网吧场景，出海网络也在同步铺开。目前，腾讯大众赛事已覆盖全球217个国家和地区，搭建全链路服务能力，今年还将推进海外官方授权与全球三方赛事布局，联动全球品牌、行业组织与平台加速出海生态建设；网吧生态与《三角洲行动》、《王者荣耀世界》、《地下城与勇士》等项目的深度联动，合作范围已包括联合出海。
AI全流程贯穿，让合作更高效、省心
异业合作过去的门槛并不低：需求沟通往往耗时一到两周，寻找游戏资源、翻找历史案例也要两到三天，人才、技术、运营经验的匮乏，更让不少中小商家望而却步。
腾讯游戏人生负责人欧阳明表示：“我们始终在思考，依托腾讯游戏强大的科技能力，如何将海量用户的游戏体验与其日常生活中的消费行为紧密连接起来，帮助我们的合作伙伴获得高质量、高效率的经营增长。”
为此，腾讯游戏人生推出了一整套AI服务，包括通过AI沉淀分析海量历史合作案例数据，帮助伙伴实现更精准的ROI把控；推出网吧小咖运营助手、赛事AI运营助手、合作方案定制助手，实现合作流程配置和经营分析自动化，为合作伙伴带来更低的合作门槛、更精准的用户触达、更高效的转化。
腾讯游戏人生合作负责人童翔则给出了AI介入前后更加直观的对比：客户需求获取从1至2周缩短到AI自动萃取不到1小时，资源与方案推荐从2至3天缩短到即时输出。AI已贯穿需求识别、方案推荐、效果预估、上线复盘到下一步合作指导的全流程，在需求识别度、资源选择精准度和客户效果满意度上“提升不止一个量级”。
他还介绍，即将上线的官方AI合作管家如同“数字员工”，吸收了历史合作中所有游戏、行业客户的优质案例和方法，伙伴用自然语言在微信或企业微信里就能获取方案，“用最短的时间拿到最好的方案”。高莉也提到，通过AI自然语音指令快速生成一场游戏赛事的能力已经成熟，并配套AI解说、字幕、复盘等增值功能。
三角洲行动 搜打撤射击FPS生存 从S8赛季的整体体验下来，《三角洲行动》可以说是在新赛季给玩家带来了相当多的惊喜，经典老地图改版能让玩家体验到诸多的新意和打法的延伸，新干员的出现也会为队伍选择提供更多的开发空间
查看更多 立即下载
在具体经营场景，AI正成为看得见的增长杠杆。据腾讯游戏人生赛事负责人黄天澜介绍，一键生成定制合作方案、AI预审提速授权、AI解说、智能数据看板、个性化用户推荐等AI功能已贯穿办赛全流程，让伙伴“办赛更简单、触达更精准、效果可量化”。
在商户场景，AI发券按消费偏好和地理位置精准匹配，由AI宠物引导使用，转化率和核销率显著提升。在网吧场景，腾讯游戏人生推出的小咖AI运营助手在不打扰游戏的前提下，于游戏间隙精准推送活动、福利与赛事，试点中同一网吧用户的在店时长最高可达接入前的2.5倍，同时这套AI运营系统也将免费开放给所有生态合作伙伴。腾讯游戏人生产品负责人江哲良称：“腾讯游戏做了一套精细化的用户运营能力，现在，我们把它免费交到每一位店主手里。”
游戏人生AI服务还延伸到了更大的社会议题。在景德镇手工瓷业遗存列入《世界遗产名录》之际，腾讯游戏以AI数字人、AI 3D生成等技术将景德镇遗产价值可视化、手工技艺可体验化，并在10款游戏端内通过皮肤、活动于景德镇进行联动，让更多年轻人重新认识景德镇，理解申遗价值。
四大场景升级，解决五大诉求
针对不同场景下合作伙伴的差异化经营诉求，腾讯游戏人生在商户、网吧、高校、赛事四大场景同步推进能力升级，把游戏能力沉淀为可低门槛接入、可复制落地的增长方案。
在商户场景中，为了让品牌从“做一次活动”走向“长期存在于游戏生态”，腾讯游戏人生推出了营销产品玩法“腾讯游戏鹅鹅”，为商户营销提升经营增长提供更有趣的形式。据腾讯游戏人生商户平台产品负责人杨娴介绍，“腾讯游戏鹅鹅”通过让玩家与品牌高效定制化互联，构建起“玩游戏、养鹅、兑换生活权益”的循环：玩家在腾讯旗下游戏中的活跃时长转化为喂养鹅的“鹅粮”，鹅蛋可兑换真实生活权益，品牌权益由此从“广告推送”变成“用户主动索取”；品牌还可共建联名道具、设置数字门店与 NFC到店任务，实现快速、稳定获客。
围绕曝光、触达、到店、私域、年轻用户五大诉求，腾讯游戏人生还提供了一套成熟的组合方案：每月20场游戏联运活动覆盖23款游戏，并新增私域绑定，玩家领奖前先加企微、进社群，精准用户沉淀后可持续运营；发券能力扩展至三角洲行动、大掼蛋、QQ 农场、QQ 网吧等多款游戏与端游场景，每款每周百万级发券量；到店环节由游戏内推送引导玩家 NFC 碰一碰或扫码打卡，物料、NFC 卡、技术系统全部由平台负责，商户零技术门槛接入。效果已经跑通：洛克王国上海站单场产生1.2万次碰卡，霸碗长沙合作订单增长228%。
网吧、高校、赛事等场景也同步完成能力升级。针对网吧业态，QQ网吧将合作模式升级为“平台×游戏×门店”三层开放生态，今年首次打通美团、大众点评与抖音，近2万家网吧获得免费曝光，到店用户同比增长40%。截至7月，专属权益让合作门店用户到店停留时间平均增长37%，粗略测算累计为合作门店带来超10亿元营收增长，英雄联盟还面向符合条件的钻石网吧开放授权赛申请通道；在高校商圈，平台开放王者荣耀119个英雄、189款皮肤及火影忍者手游、QQ炫舞手游等高校专属权益，配合NFC碰一碰精准触达大学生客群；赛事方面，平台围绕20多款核心游戏开放30多条大众赛道授权，端内商户赛已累计服务23个行业上百个品牌、曝光35.8亿次，未来将沿品牌联合办赛、政企文旅共建、实体经营、出海生态、AI迭代五大方向持续开放。
大会还以直播连线形式邀请一线合作伙伴现身说法：爷爷不泡茶渠道运营负责人刘宇航与腾讯游戏人生行业合作负责人王乐莹，交流餐饮品牌如何借助游戏发券与NFC到店玩法吸引年轻客群；英特尔中国电竞场所项目经理吴雷、网鱼副总裁林峰、顺网科技基础产品中心总监胡艳平、敞玩电竞副总经理陈肖霞与腾讯游戏人生QQ网吧平台运营负责人吴锦昌，共话硬件厂商、网维平台、连锁网吧与平台的生态共建；九号品牌市场赛事营销负责人恒昕、深湾创科总经理黄绍清与腾讯游戏人生赛事合作负责人姚瑶，分享大众赛事与商圈、实体空间结合的增长实践。
结语
作为腾讯游戏官方商户合作与赛事服务平台，腾讯游戏人生致力于以腾讯优质的游戏IP内容与解决方案能力去帮助各行各业经营增长。目前，腾讯游戏人生合作异业品牌突破6000个，年度营销节点200次以上，平台发券量突破3.5亿份；赛事侧覆盖20多款核心游戏、30多条大众赛道，触达8000万核心用户，凝聚2000多家深度合作伙伴；QQ网吧月用户规模突破5000万，2022年至2025年月活翻2.5倍。
当前，游戏早已走出娱乐单一场景，成为触达年轻人、激发消费场景、连接全球市场的重要引擎。2026腾讯游戏人生全球合作伙伴大会所展示的，不仅是一系列新产品、新能力与新政策，更是一条游戏与实业“创·享新机遇”的共赢长线。在多元化的产业联动中，腾讯游戏人生或将成为更多行业品牌打开年轻市场、奔赴全球增长的重要支点。

title: "The End" Has Finally Reached the Starting Point
text:
P.S.: Spoiler alert!
Ever since it entered open beta earlier this year, I’ve felt that *Arknights: The End of the World* (hereinafter referred to as *The End of the World*) has always been just a step short of perfection.
This has nothing to do with the game’s quality. Rather, after several updates that have improved the content—such as cinematic sequences and multi-layered storytelling—and optimized the experience—such as reducing the burden of base-building—it’s become very difficult to find any flaws in terms of quality.
By “falling just short,” I mean that *The End* has consistently lacked a breakthrough moment that would allow it to truly shine and demonstrate commercial success commensurate with its quality.
The reasons behind this are relatively complex. On the market front, the decline in the overall anime and manga market and the saturation of the anime and manga gaming player base, combined with product-related factors—such as an initial focus on infrastructure and a brand-new numerical validation model—have all prevented *The End* from fully unleashing its potential.
Just yesterday, the “Danqing Du” update for *The End* was released, and that very night, it shot straight into the Top 3 on the iOS Top Grossing Games chart, setting a new all-time high.
The reason this version was able to set a new record for the Endlands update is primarily because, as the core chapter concluding the Wuling arc, “Danqing Ferry” not only expanded the game’s world-building but also facilitated the in-depth development of the player character, the “Administrator.”
More importantly, this version can be described as the culmination of the integrated experience that Eagle Corner has built in *The Endlands* by combining game mechanics, cultural essence, and the game’s world-building concepts—as I’ve mentioned before.
01
Entering the Painting, Realizing the Mind
Broadly speaking, the narrative of this version revolves around an administrator who, in order to heal the trans-dimensional damage left behind by past battles, is led by Si into a world within a painting—a world constructed using Si’s own powers—where the administrator undergoes trials that blur the lines between reality and illusion.
In fact, in the tradition of Chinese landscape painting, there is a specific term for stepping into a painting to experience and appreciate it: “wo you.”
Zong Bing, a painter of the Southern Dynasties, described this experience in his “Preface to Landscape Painting”: Unable to travel in person during his later years, he painted the landscapes he had once visited on the wall, lay facing the wall, and used the paintings as a substitute for travel, allowing his spirit to wander through them.Most importantly, Zong Bing also introduced one of the key aesthetic concepts in Chinese painting theory: “chàng shén” (liberating the spirit). Put simply, this means that viewing a painting can soothe the mind and liberate the spirit.
However, while Zong Bing’s “Lying-Down Travel” involved traveling through paintings, the ultimate goal is to allow the administrator—that is, the player—to step directly into the painting and explore it from within.
In fact, whether one is viewing a painting or becoming part of it, the core aesthetic philosophy of Chinese landscape painting—which emphasizes negative space and free-spirited expression—is fundamentally about creating space for the “mind.” As the saying goes, “Draw inspiration from nature externally, and find the source within the mind.”
Chinese landscape painters often draw inspiration from nature and look inward to gain spiritual insight; the landscapes in their paintings are both artistic representations of real terrain and projections of the artists’ inner worlds.
I’m not sure if this is a metaphor intended by the production team, but when combined with the plotline involving the Administrator’s healing, using a landscape painting as the story’s setting is indeed very fitting conceptually. This is because, once you’ve played through the story, you’ll realize that this healing process is less about repairing the Administrator’s physical injuries and more like a journey of spiritual healing.
But back to the main point: the realm the Administrator has entered was created through the power of ritual and the will left behind by past Administrators; here, traces of memories from the outside world blend with the emotional landscapes deep within the heart.
As he entered the painting, the story Si told resembled *The Record of the Peach Blossom Spring*—and, as it happens,this classical Chinese text is all too familiar to players who have completed nine years of compulsory education. Not only does it echo the sense of a hidden realm in Si’s painted world, but it also introduces the central theme of the interplay between reality and imagination: what the administrator sees and hears within the painting is both real and a product of the mind.
Setting aside the gravity field that Xiao Cong created inside the inn,
Slow down a bit, girls
There is also some debate about the form that the administrator’s treatment process ultimately took—namely, mountain climbing.
Mountain climbing—or, more broadly, ascending to heights—has a clear spiritual significance in the Chinese literary tradition. As the lines go, “To see a thousand li into the distance, I must climb one more story,” and “I shall ascend to the very summit, where all other mountains seem small.” The ascent in elevation always corresponds to the broadening of one’s perspective and the expansion of one’s spiritual horizons.
Let’s take a look at what the prison warden encountered while climbing the mountain. First up is the “Ma Liang and the Magic Brush” incident in Xiaohe Village—I call this the “painting correction.”
When the Administrator and Si arrived, Xiaohe Village was in decline; with the exception of Village Chief Li, all the villagers were planning to move away. The Administrator used his paintbrush to depict a bountiful harvest, repaired the waterwheel, and breathed new life into the ginkgo tree, which the villagers regarded as a spiritual totem.
The ink-wash paintings inspired by the power of ritual here serve a narrative function: as the brushstrokes fall, withered objects come back to life, and restoration becomes creation.
Throughout this process, although the villagers could not see the two village administrators, they came to realize once again that it was they themselves who had first cleared this land and built their homes; that the ginkgo tree was merely a tree, and that the true force sustaining the village to this day comes from the people themselves.
Here, the administrator gained a correction to his first-level understanding: the ginkgo tree essentially serves as a metaphor for the core protocol of integrated industry. However, technological tools are, after all, merely means to an end; it is the spirit of exploration and the will to forge ahead that form the foundation for the continuation of civilization.
It is worth noting Eagle Corner’s reinterpretation of the Peach Blossom Spring motif.In my view, Xiahe Village is a parody of the Peach Blossom Spring described by Tao Yuanming; the latter is a static utopia, cut off from the outside world and self-contained, whereas Xiahe Village is in a state of decline and requires an “outsider” to revitalize it.
This actually implies a shift in the narrative’s central theme—from withdrawal from the world to engagement with it—inherent to the “Endland” narrative itself, allowing the classical imagery of the Peach Blossom Spring to resonate with the theme of exploration consistently emphasized in “Endland,” as well as with the administrator’s own circumstances.
The second level—a Chinese chess endgame—offers an even clearer hint about one’s own situation.
Upon leaving Xiaohe Village, the administrator had to deal with three chess games he had left unfinished in the past.
There’s not much to say about the process of breaking the deadlock, but on a narrative level, these three games served to solidify the administrator’s sense of identity.
If we were to say that administrators in the past were like chess players—who held the full picture and controlled the game—then administrators who have lost most of their memories after waking up have gone from being players to pawns, trapped within the game with a limited field of vision.
However, the deadlock in the third game made the administrator realize that the position of the pieces also holds unique value. It is precisely because he was in the midst of the game that he could perceive the local realities beyond the players’ reach, inject new variables into the stalemate through his own actions, and—by becoming a piece himself—turn a dead end into a living one and turn defeat into victory.
The interactive design, in which players control the administrator as they step onto the game board, also echoes this meaning; the shift in perspective—from observing the game to becoming part of it—is in itself a key part of the experience.
In other words, from the chess player to the chess piece, the Administrator has here confirmed and accepted his current situation—and perhaps indirectly addressed another mystery on the narrative level, such as the reason the Administrator chose to restart the system ten years ago.
So, when I read the section on Chinese chess, it pretty much clicked for me: the ultimate victory must be the administrator’s final act of clearing away confusion and facing their inner self head-on.
Sure enough, beneath the Di Jiang at the mountaintop, when Night River opened the final gap in the painting for the administrator, the administrator was confronted with the true nature of trans-domain damage: it was more like a wedge driven deep into the mind—a persistent form of mental interference.
Phantoms of Nefis, Adashir, and even the Administrator himself appeared one after another, launching round after round of questioning—questions directed at the Administrator himself regarding “what he is.”
The power that ultimately broke through the barrier came from the companions in Valley No. 4 and Wuling. Their figures appeared at the moment when the Administrator was most wavering, serving as an anchor that dispelled the fog.
Later on, the administrator encountered his own past will, which had been preserved through the power of sacrifice.
The two versions of himself from different timelines came face to face, and the administrator from the past listened to the entire story of what had happened since he woke up. Together, they arrived at a simple conclusion: his original intention was not merely to save the world, but rather to love—and to “be with everyone.”
As for the question of identity—“Who am I?”—that has always troubled me, an administrator can be an administrator, or anyone else; it is always one’s actions and choices that define who one is.
Looking back at the beginning of the story, after the administrator woke up, his memory had been wiped clean; his past identity, past relationships, and past decisions were all unreliable.
Eastern traditions approach the question of “Who am I?” in a way that differs fundamentally from the Western approach. Western philosophy tends to seek a fixed, definable “self” as the cornerstone of all cognition.
Dude… Dude…
In Chinese philosophy, the self is never an isolated entity; Chinese philosophy holds that clinging to a fixed and unchanging “self” is, in itself, the root of suffering.
The answer that the administrator ultimately confirmed points to relationships and actions: who I am depends on whose side I choose to stand on and on what I do. Identity is defined by behavior, and the self is revealed through connection.
This was an epiphany at Longchang, reflecting one answer to the philosophical question of “Who am I?” posed on Tower Guard II through the perspective of the Endland administrator.
At the same time, it features a narrative centered on the “protagonist’s growth”—a theme I haven’t seen in anime and manga in a long time. Especially now that amnesia plots are all the rage and protagonist characterization has become one-dimensional and formulaic, this represents a rare and clearly defined character arc.
The narrative in the “Danqing Du” version made me realize that perhaps my recent travels through Valley 4 and Wuling were merely the prologue to the story of the Endlands—just the tip of the iceberg of what’s to come. In the future, we’ll see even more factions make their debut, such as Rhodes Island and Keystone…It is only now that the “cold start” of the Endlands has officially been completed.
In other words, Yingjiao’s 3D title *Arknights: The End of the World* has only just begun its journey.
02
The Beginning of the Endlands
From a product perspective, the significance of a single version must be understood within a broader context.
Since its launch, *End of the World* has faced a central challenge: how to translate Eagle角’s accumulated narrative expertise into a cohesive experience within a 3D game.
In other words, it’s about creating a sense of “realism.” Eagle Corner has a unique ability to make players believe that behind the UI and HUD lies another “present moment” that is unfolding.
Arknights’ storytelling primarily relies on a rich imaginative world crafted through a combination of extensive text, music, and level design. The narrative offers diverse perspectives and ample scope, allowing for the use of tens of thousands of characters to build the cultural fabric of a region or world.
The medium for 3D products is entirely different; cultural information must be embedded throughout the entire production chain—including scenes, interactions, animations, lighting, and audio—which actually limits the duration of a single narrative.
In an interview at this year’s Gamescom, Wei@W, Art Director of *Arknights: The End of the World*, also mentioned that during the project’s development, they realized that the narrative scope of cinematic storytelling in AAA games is far narrower than that of 2D “electronic novel”-style games, and that current production capacity for scenes and characters is insufficient to support the kind of world-building seen in *Arknights*.
To be frank, this isn’t just a challenge facing Eagle角; it’s a dilemma shared by the entire indie gaming industry amid the shift toward 3D. For games that prioritize concepts and storytelling, 2D text and character art are naturally well-suited for conveying large amounts of information, but the cultural expression in 3D games cannot simply replicate the logic of 2D.
Because 3D products are, by their very nature, a medium driven by real-time interaction, players’ attention is divided among countless touchpoints—such as exploring the environment, combat maneuvers, and system interactions—and lengthy text in this context is not only ineffective but can even be counterproductive to immersion.
As a result, two approaches have emerged within the industry: one involves condensing the narrative into fragmented environmental storytelling, hiding text, letters, and voice logs within the game world, and using exploration to drive information discovery; the other involves increasing investment in production, using high-quality CG and cutscenes to amplify key narrative moments and ensure that emotional peaks are effectively conveyed.
Both approaches have their merits, but each also has its limitations. The former tends to make narrative an optional element, with the intensity of cultural expression diluted by the frequency of exploration; the latter, on the other hand, tends to turn the game into a cinematic experience, making it difficult to integrate interaction and narrative, with a lack of cohesion between the two.
Based on the overall performance of this version of *The Endlands*, I believe Eagle角 has found a strategy for balancing interaction and storytelling in its 3D games.
In this ink-wash painting game, the interactive elements correspond to narrative actions of restoration and creation. Players use their brushes to revive ginkgo trees and set waterwheels in motion again; these interactions drive the narrative forward while conveying the theme that “people can rebuild the world through their own will.”
The interactive experience of stepping into the game board transforms the abstract concept of “joining the game” into a spatial experience. In each level, what the player does mirrors what the administrator is experiencing, blending gameplay mechanics with the narrative.
Furthermore, during the ascent—the process of paving the way with a paintbrush—the various interactions, from technical implementation to artistic presentation, were by no means effortless. Their purpose was to ensure that this narrative, in which the administrator heals their inner world and strengthens their resolve, achieved a depth of experience that only the medium of gaming can provide.
Whether climbing mountains, painting, or playing chess, as players engage in these interactions, they are also personally experiencing the administrator’s philosophical journey. Every action players take within the painted world serves not only as gameplay but also as a means of advancing the narrative and as a cultural experience; gameplay, story, and culture are fully integrated into a single form of expression.
From this perspective, the “Danqing Du” version represents a key milestone in Yingjiao’s transition to 3D. When game mechanics themselves become a vehicle for cultural expression, the expressive power of the 3D medium is fully unleashed—delivering an extraordinary sense of cultural immersion and narrative engagement to players.
This is the unique, three-in-one fusion of interaction, narrative, and culture that defines *The Endland*—and it is likely the distinctive approach that Eagle角 has developed for itself in the realm of 3D gaming.
Furthermore, the production scheduling in this version has also been taken to the next level.
In the “Climax: See Me” sequence, the pacing of the storyboard—where the administrator converses with his past self—the visual treatment when his companions appear, and the shifts in light and shadow within the depicted world at the narrative climax all combine to create the most emotionally intense cutscene in *The End* to date.
From its early days, when performances primarily served to convey information, the project has evolved through iterations to the point where it can now create emotions and shape cultural atmospheres on this scale. The team’s collaborative growth in storyboarding, animation, and audio coordination is also clearly evident.
So, at this point, you might understand why I say the “Danqing Du” version has the potential to be a major hit in the Endlands.
Because it accomplishes three things at once.
First, it achieves a complete integration of gameplay, culture, and world-building within a single version, providing a preliminary answer to the question of what the End should ultimately look like—namely, creating a cohesive experience.
Second, it brings to a close the first complete character arc for the Administrator since his awakening.The Administrator’s quest to discover his true identity and his resulting confusion have been laid out since the very first version and have remained unresolved until now. Now, the Administrator has reaffirmed his original purpose, accepted the fluidity of his identity, and reconciled with his past self. On a narrative level, the protagonist has gained a stable foothold, and the challenges he faces moving forward will shift from confusion to confronting difficult choices head-on.
While completing the character development for this version, the game also strengthened the protagonist’s characterization. This achievement clearly goes beyond the conventional strategy for anime-style products, which typically focuses on developing core commercial characters as the main content of each version.
Third, it marks the official completion of the “cold start” for the Endlands.Following the conclusion of the Wuling arc, a deeper worldview is emerging. The introduction of factions such as Rhodes Island in subsequent updates, further revelations about the Cornerstone’s truth, and increased intersections between the Endlands and the Ark’s original lore all signal that the Endlands are about to enter a phase with greater narrative depth and a broader expansion of its world-building.
From proof of concept to pipeline refinement and content iteration, Zhongmudi spent more than half a year making a significant leap forward. I believe the “Danqingdu” version marks the turning point where Zhongmudi moved from its initial phase into its growth phase.
Conclusion
Of course, you might ask, “Is the End now completely problem-free?”
Maybe it’s not that bad—for example, there’s still no way to craft skill materials (grrr).
However, what you can clearly sense is that the progress—or rather, the changes—from one version to the next have been very noticeable. The issues that plagued the game when it first launched have now been reduced to less than one-tenth of what they were, and the game now runs so smoothly that it’s practically a completely different game.
Ultimately, for any product with a long-term vision, the most crucial factor will always be whether players are willing to believe that the future will be better.
The journey that begins after the starting point is what’s truly exciting.

title: From *Red Tide* to *Black Myth*, from “Rising Stars” to Publicly Traded Companies: A Look Back at the Industry’s Evolution Over the Past Thirteen Years of the Golden Tea Awards
text:
Prior to *Black Myth: Wukong*, Game Science had made the list of Golden Tea Award winners with *Red Tide: The Art of War*. Before the release of *Celadon*, it was listed as an “up-and-coming company.” *This City Has Good Farmland* appeared on the lists of award winners for both casual games and mini-games.
Looking through these old lists again today, I see many familiar names—names that, back then, were part of a different story.
In September 2013, Game Teahouse was founded. Four months later, on January 18, 2014, the first Golden Tea Awards were held in Chengdu. The thirteen subsequent award ceremonies coincided with the years during which China’s mobile gaming industry transitioned from a startup boom to maturity.
In 2012, the actual revenue of China’s mobile gaming market was only 3.24 billion yuan; by 2025, it had reached 257.076 billion yuan.As the market expanded, so did the ways of making games: some developers have been operating a single title for a decade; others have expanded their businesses overseas; some have shifted their focus to PC and console games; and still others have found new users through casual games.
Traces of these changes can be found in the lists of past Golden Tea Award winners.
Starting in Chengdu
In 2012, revenue in China’s mobile gaming market grew by 90.6% year-over-year, and the user base reached 89 million, a 73.7% increase from the previous year. Looking back today, the market was not particularly large at the time, but both revenue and the user base were growing rapidly.
The first Golden Tea Awards primarily focused on Chengdu and the southwestern region, recognizing tourism products, individuals, companies, and up-and-coming teams. By the second edition, the scope had expanded to the entire country, with both domestic and international tourism products and companies included in the selection process.
“Mobile games,” “up-and-comers,” and “going global” were terms that appeared repeatedly on the initial list.
These milestones corresponded to several major events for game companies at the time: developing their first mobile game, finding a publisher, ensuring the team’s survival, and then considering expanding overseas. Some companies that later became quite well-known first came to the attention of the Golden Tea Awards during this phase.
Game Science: They Were Still Working on *Red Tide* When They Won the Award
In the list of winners for the 2017 Golden Tea Award for Best Mobile Esports Game, *Red Tide: Art of War* appeared alongside titles such as *Honor of Kings*, *Hearthstone*, and *Rules of Survival*.
Developed by Game Science and published by Hero Entertainment, this title initially garnered attention for its strategic combat and competitive gameplay. Seven years later, on August 20, 2024, Game Science’s *Black Myth: Wukong* officially launched on the PS5 and various PC platforms.
When people talk about Game Science today, most immediately think of *Black Myth*. But *Red Tide* is also a milestone in this team’s journey. The old roster preserves their history from before they became widely known for *Black Myth*.
From mobile esports to single-player action games, the genres, platforms, and product formats have all changed. For Game Science, the mobile gaming market it operated in back then did not limit its subsequent creative direction.
Celadon and Paper Stacks: Keeping Our Game Going
Among the list of the “Top Ten Emerging Domestic Game Companies” for the 2015 Golden Tea Awards is a Xiamen-based company—Qingci Digital.
Later, Qingci launched *The Strongest Snail* and went public in Hong Kong on December 16, 2021.But a look at the prospectus reveals that the company had already come a long way before its breakout hit: it launched *Mystery Dungeon* in 2016, *Ares Virus* in 2018, and *The Strongest Snail* in 2020.
The story of how *Ares Virus* won the Golden Tea Award for Best Independent Game was also included in the prospectus.
These games vary in gameplay and style. If you look only at *The Strongest Snail*, it’s easy to attribute Qingci’s growth to a single hit title; but if you trace the company’s history back, you’ll see its earlier attempts.
Diedi Paper has had a similar experience.
In 2019, DiDi Paper won the Best Mobile Game Publisher award at the Golden Tea Awards. Since then, *Love & Deep Space* and *Infinite Nuan Nuan* have become its flagship titles. In August 2025, *Love & Deep Space* went on to win the Best Mobile Game award at the Gamescom.
From domestic industry awards to international trade shows, Diezi has consistently developed products tailored to its core user base while increasing investment in R&D and experimenting with new forms of expression.
The story of Qingci and Diezhi isn’t just one of a “small company that grew into a major player.” What were once considered relatively niche approaches and user needs can, after years of operation, become the backbone of a company’s core business.
“Youth Three Kingdoms”: How Long Can a Game Last?
On the old list, some companies have gone through several rounds of product updates, while some games have remained on the list the entire time.
“Youth Three Kingdoms” was launched in 2015 and won the “Best Long-Running Game” award at the 2022 Golden Tea Awards. At the time of the award, the game was approaching its eighth anniversary.
Youzu Network’s 2022 annual report revealed that, as of that time, *Young Three Kingdoms* had accumulated over 140 million registered users and generated total global revenue exceeding 6.6 billion yuan.
These figures are the result of years of operation. After the game launches, we’ll continue to update the content, make adjustments to the versions, and constantly give existing players reasons to stay.
In an industry where new releases and hit products are constantly in the spotlight, *Youth Three Kingdoms* reminds us that there is another category of products worth paying attention to: they may not be the center of attention every year, but they have a steady user base and continue to thrive.
The Golden Tea Award has established a separate category specifically for long-term operations, focusing precisely on these products.
From *Legend of the Bow and Arrow* to *This City Has Good Farmland*
The list of casual games changes even faster than company names.
In 2019, notable award-winning titles included *Dream Garden*, *Legend of the Bow and Arrow*, and *Travel Skewers*; in 2022, they included *Lie Back and Level Up*, *Shell Strike Force*, and *The Hot Pot Restaurant on the Road to Happiness*;In 2024, *A Home Deep in the Peach Blossom Spring* and *Heart-Fluttering Town* made their debut.
Although they’re all called casual games, the activities players engage in vary greatly: some can be played for just one round before being set aside, some involve management and character development, and others incorporate social interaction and community life into the game.
The case of *This City Has Good Farmland* is even more interesting. It appeared on the list of the best casual games of 2023 and was subsequently included in the list of outstanding mini-games of 2024.
The two awards recognized different aspects: one focused on the game genre, while the other focused on how the product operates and reaches users. The “mini-games” platform is now capable of supporting more complex content and long-term operations.
The Golden Tea Awards’ focus on this type of product did not begin just in the past two years. As early as the sixth edition of the awards, a category for “Best H5 Mini-Game of 2018” was established, and titles such as *Sword of the Archangel H5*, *Legend Has Arrived*, and *H5 Three Kingdoms Kill* were all on the list that year.
From H5 to mini-programs, the entry points for games are evolving, and developers are increasing their investment in this market. In 2025, the revenue of the domestic mini-program gaming market reached 53.535 billion yuan, a year-over-year increase of 34.39%. Of this, in-app purchases accounted for 68.11%, while advertising revenue accounted for 31.89%.
These figures are increasingly difficult to reconcile with the early perception of casual games as something you “play for a few minutes and watch a few ads.” More and more products are beginning to incorporate progression systems, content, and long-term monetization models within this platform.
When will indie games and PC games be added to the list?
In addition to mobile games, the Golden Tea Awards have gradually expanded to include other categories.
According to the award records for the first five editions published by Game Teahouse, the Independent Game Award was not yet listed in the first three editions. The fourth edition, held on January 11, 2017, introduced the “Best Independent Game of the Year” category for the 2016 awards, with *Yesterday* serving as the representative winner that year.
The list that followed featured an ever-increasing variety of game genres. In 2017, the list included *Monument Valley 2*, *Genki Knight*, *Dream Traveler*, and *At the End: The Trial of Rebirth*; in 2018, it included *Ares Virus*, *Romance of the Three Kingdoms: The Rise of the Han Dynasty*, and *Ninja Must Die 3*.
This also shows that the indie games selected in the early years of the Golden Tea Awards were not limited to single-player PC titles; they included quite a few mobile games as well.
As for the standalone PC game category, the earliest verifiable record in currently available public information dates back to 2020. The call for entries for the 8th edition listed “Best PC Game” and “Best Indie Game” as separate categories, and *Gunfire Reborn* won the Best PC Game award that year. According to information disclosed by Duoyi Network at the time, the game surpassed one million copies sold within six months of its launch.
Later, *BlazBlue: Chaos Effect* and *Soul Mask* were named the Best PC Games of 2023 and 2024, respectively.
*The Legend of the Living Hero* documents the journey from winning an award to its official release. According to Sheng Tian Network’s 2024 annual report, this title—published by its subsidiary Paras Studio—won the “2022 Golden Tea Award for Best Independent Game” and officially launched on Steam in the second quarter of 2024.
Looking back at these lists, it’s important to distinguish between three concepts: “PC” refers to the platform, “single-player” refers to the product format, and “indie game” relates to the development and creative process. While there is some overlap among these three, they cannot simply be treated as the same category. To date, there are no reliable records of a separate award for “Best Single-Player Game,” but single-player titles have long been included in indie and PC game awards.
From *Yesterday* to *The Legend of the Living Hero*, and from *Gunfire Reborn* to *Soul Mask*, the changes in the list are quite evident: what began as a selection focused primarily on mobile games has gradually come to include more titles from various platforms and teams of all sizes.
Going Global: From “Dragon Soaring in the Middle East” to More Markets
“Going Global” has been a category in the Golden Tea Awards for quite some time. As early as the second edition of the awards, there was already an award for “Promising Global Expansion Products and Companies.”
The list of the best overseas game companies for 2017 included Longteng Jianhe, 37 Interactive Entertainment, Youzu Network, and Zhuohang, among others. These companies subsequently took different paths.
The changes at Longteng are most evident in its name.
On December 7, 2017, the company published a notice on its official website announcing that “Longteng Middle East” had been renamed “Longteng Jianhe.” According to the explanation in the notice, the company’s business scale and organizational structure had outgrown the meaning conveyed by its original name.
The “Middle East” was once this company’s most distinctive hallmark. *The Sultan’s Revenge* drew on themes from the Arab world, incorporating cultural elements familiar to local users into a strategy game. Subsequently, titles such as *The Rise of the King* expanded the company’s reach into additional markets.
Establish a strong foothold in one region first, then expand into other markets—the name “Longteng” reflects this journey.
37 Interactive Entertainment’s overseas business, meanwhile, has found a breakthrough in the integration of gameplay.
Launched in 2020, *Puzzles & Survival* combines match-3 gameplay with strategy elements.According to 37 Interactive Entertainment’s 2024 annual report, this title has generated cumulative revenue exceeding 10 billion yuan and ranked among the top eight in Sensor Tower’s 2024 list of highest-grossing overseas mobile games. Its follow-up, *Puzzles & Chaos*, continued to evolve along the “match-3 + SLG” model.
Here, beyond distribution capabilities, figuring out how to design gameplay mechanics and attract users to the game has also become a crucial part of overseas operations.
In the global mobile gaming market during that same period, FunPlus was also a name that couldn’t be ignored. In 2019, when Game Tea House reported on App Annie’s June revenue rankings for global publishers, FunPlus topped the list, with *King of Avalon* and *Age of Muskets* having become its flagship titles.
The operation of these products continued into the future. *King of Avalon* launched a PC version in 2023, while *State of Survival* has continued to operate through content updates and IP collaborations. From initial performance at launch to version and platform expansions years later, overseas operations also require a long-term approach.
DianDian Interactive has added yet another twist to this story.
At the 12th Golden Tea Awards, DianDian Interactive was named “Outstanding Global Game Company of 2024,” *Whiteout Survival* was named “Outstanding Global Game of the Year,” and *Endless Winter* was named “Best Mobile Game of the Year.”
Prior to “Ice and Snow World,” DianDian Interactive had been operating farm and casual games for many years.According to Century Huatong’s 2024 annual report, the *Family Farm* series has amassed over 150 million cumulative users after more than a decade of operation. *Whiteout Survival* subsequently became a new source of growth, with DianDian Interactive generating approximately 15 billion yuan in revenue in 2024—a year-over-year increase of 155 percent.
In April of that same year, *Endless Winter* was launched on the WeChat Mini Games platform. The product experience gained in overseas markets was thus brought to the domestic mini-games platform.
Longteng Jianhe started in a single region; 37 Interactive Entertainment experimented with blending gameplay styles; FunPlus continued to develop strategic products; and DianDian Interactive brought its overseas experience back to China. More than a decade ago, “going global” was just a category on a list; later, each company developed its own products and business models.
Go through the old list one more time
An annual list captures the companies and works that were in the spotlight at the time. What happens afterward is often more interesting than the awards ceremony itself.
The up-and-coming companies of that era went public; mobile game development teams shifted to single-player games; and one older game continued to win awards even in its eighth year of operation. Some changed their company names, some switched platforms, and others continued to develop the same type of product, retaining their user base.
Game Teahouse was founded during the peak years of the mobile gaming startup boom. After 13 editions of the Golden Tea Awards, many of the early winners have come a long way, leaving behind plenty of stories worth revisiting.
The next time the list is updated, we may see some new changes. For Game Teahouse, these stories following the awards are certainly worth continuing to cover and write about.

title: Not a mobile game: Tencent once kept a new console version of "Assassin's Creed" under wraps
text:
According to foreign media reports, Tencent’s TiMi Studio Group had been developing a new mainline *Assassin’s Creed* title for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S, but the game may have been canceled as early as the beginning of 2025. However, this report comes from a single source and has not been corroborated by other media outlets.
This new game, developed by Ubisoft in collaboration with TiMi Studios, is titled *Assassin’s Creed: Destiny*.The game is set in the turbulent final years of the Qin Dynasty in 206 BC, nine years later than the events of *Assassin’s Creed: Jade* (a mobile game developed by TiMi Studios), and the storylines are independent of one another.
In the currently disclosed demo (a February 2025 prototype), a female assassin infiltrates a temple besieged by Xiang Yu. The demo features an early version of the Xiang Yu boss battle, an umbrella-shaped spinning weapon, ink-wash-style skill icons, and a Yin-Yang emblem UI.There is also a sequence showing a male character performing parkour, suggesting the game may offer a choice of gender.
Tianmei Cancels the Game Following a Restructuring
In January 2025, Tencent Games officially announced the reorganization of the TiMi Studios Group, consolidating more than ten studios into four major R&D sub-studios—J1, L1, J3, and T1—as well as Z1 Studio, which focuses on incubating innovation, and G1 Studio, which was responsible for global products (later dissolved).
F1 Studios, which has teams based in Los Angeles and Seattle in the U.S., Montreal in Canada, and Singapore, has been merged into J1.
Around the same time, development on *Assassin’s Creed: Destiny* was halted.
In March 2026, Ubisoft mentioned in its official blog post, “Assassin’s Creed: Into 2026,” that “some early projects were scrapped”; perhaps *Destiny* was among them.
Meanwhile, although *Assassin’s Creed: Jade* was announced several years ago, its development status remains unclear. According to a previous report by Reuters, staff from the *Assassin’s Creed: Jade* team were temporarily reassigned to support the *Yuan Meng Zhi Xing* project. In March of this year, Ubisoft confirmed that *Assassin’s Creed: Jade* is still in development.
As “Assassin’s Creed” is Ubisoft’s most valuable core IP, both Tencent and Ubisoft are approaching the new title with great caution.
In March 2025, Tencent invested 1.16 billion euros in Vantage Studios, a newly established subsidiary of Ubisoft that holds the rights to three core IPs: *Assassin’s Creed*, *Rainbow Six*, and *Far Cry*.

title: Lo-Fi×心理悬疑冒险游戏《Rain98》Steam体验版正式上线，游玩时长超过3小时！
text:
总部位于东京・涩谷的游戏工作室“C#4R4CT3R”宣布，正在开发的首部作品《Rain98》体验版已于2026年10月17日(周六，日本时间)在Steam正式上线。
在美国旧金山The MIX主办的线上展示活动“The MIX Fall Game Showcase”中，公开了收录游戏内画面的全新预告片。配合在节目中的发表，Steam免费体验版也同步上线。
本次体验版时长约3小时，收录了从故事开篇到第2章前半段的内容。除了小说部分外，在冒险部分中，玩家还可以体验与女主角·雨原玲奈的互动，以及探索1998年的东京街头。本作支持日语、英语、中文(简体/繁体)、韩语、葡萄牙语(巴西)、西班牙语(拉丁美洲)、法语、德语共9种语言，将本作的故事带给全世界的玩家。
此外，还公布了新角色『夜濑京子』将由能登麻美子出演，并在新预告片中首次公开了她的语音。
『Rain98』
1998年，东京。不肯停息的落雨，寻求灭亡的少女。
《Rain98》是一款以1998年东京为舞台，描绘与女主角·雨原玲奈(CV：土屋李央)共度时光的Lo-Fi×心理悬疑冒险游戏(ADV)。
游戏由推进故事的小说部分，以及享受与玲奈互动和探索街头的冒险部分构成。伴随着Lo-Fi音效，将玩家引入一个弥漫着不安气息的世界。
可从头体验故事开篇的免费体验版正式公开
自2025年4月发表以来，《Rain98》曾在各类游戏活动中提供试玩，如今终于以Steam免费体验版的形式登场。本作支持日语、英语等多种语言，任何人都可以在自己家中的PC上体验本作的世界。
此前的demo均为从故事中途开始游玩的形式，而本次体验版则收录了从故事开篇到第2章前半段的内容。约3小时的容量，可让玩家细细体验与玲奈的对话和互动、街头探索、小游戏等本作的多种要素。
此外，在街头探索方面，相比在9月举办的“TOKYO GAME SHOW 2026”上公开的最新demo，本次体验版进一步扩大了行动范围，玩家还可以前往雨中的涩谷街头。请一边感受1998年涩谷的氛围，一边享受与玲奈共度的每一天。
在今后体验版的更新中，我们将追加第2章的后篇，让玩家可以玩到第2章结尾。更新后，也可以从之前的存档处继续游玩。正式版的游玩时间预计约为10～15小时。请大家先通过体验版，享受这个故事的开端。今后的信息将在Steam商店页面及官方社媒(SNS)陆续公布。在官方Discord中，开发成员会分享开发进度等最新信息，大家也可以自由投稿游玩感想和对故事的考察。欢迎随时来玩。
※试玩版发布后，该页面将开放访问。
体验版的看点
与玲奈共度的私密时光
伴随着与玲奈共度的时光，玩家将一点点地接触到隐藏在她身后的秘密。
通过副业小游戏来维持生活
通过在宅兼职赚取金钱，为日常生活提供保障也是玩家的任务。随着收入的增加，与玲奈共度的生活也会变得更加多姿多彩。
与玲奈一同，前往雨中的涩谷
走出公寓，与玲奈一起前往雨幕下的街头。在浓郁的世纪末气息当中探索过去的涩谷吧。
音乐与影像交织的《Rain98》世界
与雨声交叠的Lo-Fi音效，营造出舒适与不安交织的氛围。细腻的画面与丰富的动画，将进一步加深玩家对故事的沉浸感。
能登麻美子确定出演『夜濑京子』
官方宣布，将由能登麻美子出演《Rain98》中登场的谜之女性角色。在新预告片和体验版中，可以听到她的一部分语音。在故事中她将如何参与，还敬请关注今后的展开。
能登麻美子
出身于石川县。除了动画和游戏出演外，还广泛活跃于旁白、歌手等领域。
主要出演作品包括《好想告诉你》黑沼爽子、《地狱少女》阎魔爱、《机动战士高达 水星的魔女》普洛斯佩拉·墨丘利等。
《Rain98》总监·Shoon T 寄语
终于快到了，大家能玩到《Rain98》的这一天了。太好啦!
想到会有这么多的玩家能够玩到本作，团队全体感到既紧张又非常兴奋。
在阴雨连绵的1998年东京，和玲奈一起到处逛吃、一起走在街上，被她拉着玩些奇奇怪怪的游戏。
被她折腾得团团转，度过一段有些不安、又有些好笑的、只属于你和玲奈的难忘日常——如果大家能享受这段时光，我会很开心。
虽然本次体验版只进行到第2章中间部分，但我们计划今后更新可以玩到第2章结尾的版本。
而在由全7章构成的正式版中，我们更打算带大家前往完全无法想象的世界。
在那前方，究竟会遇见什么呢?还敬请期待我们的游戏!
C#4R4CT3R官方社媒(SNS)会发布关于《Rain98》的最新信息。
在Discord中，还会由开发者分享游戏进度、公开制作中的美术作品以及开发幕后故事等，可以第一时间了解《Rain98》的制作过程。
请务必关注今后的最新信息。
▼《Rain98》体验版信息
收录范围：从故事开篇到第2章前半段
预计游玩时间：约3小时
支持语言：日语、英语、中文(简体/繁体)、韩语、葡萄牙语(巴西)、西班牙语(拉丁美洲)、法语、德语
语音：日语
发行平台：Steam
价格：免费
■About “C#4R4CT3R”
C#4R4CT3R是一家以角色为核心，打造全新游戏体验的游戏工作室。我们将创造出拥有独一无二绝妙个性的角色，为玩家带来难忘的体验。
■厂牌概要
厂牌名 C#4R4CT3R
所在地　 Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan
设立　　 2025年4月1日

title: 赛制全新升级！决胜巅峰MCT EA乌兰巴托站10月29日开赛
text:
10月29日至31日，决胜巅峰东亚冠军巡回赛（MCT EA）将在蒙古国乌兰巴托M Bank Arena举行。以“TAKE ON THE WORLD”为号召，来自中国、蒙古国、韩国和日本的六支战队将齐聚赛场，在三天的角逐中争夺本站冠军。
作为东亚赛区之间交流与竞技的窗口，本届MCT EA乌兰巴托站赛事将连续三天展开。10月29日进行小组赛，10月30日进入淘汰赛，10月31日迎来总决赛，各比赛日均于北京时间13:00开赛。中国与蒙古国各有两支战队参赛，韩国与日本各有一支战队出战。六支队伍小组赛分组同步公布，A组由中国战队DFYG、蒙古国战队MIO AHP及韩国队伍Zero Gravity组成；B组则汇集蒙古国战队The MongolZ、中国战队GZG及日本战队Tokyo Cinnamon。
小组赛将采用组内单循环赛制，所有比赛均为BO2，即每场进行两局对抗。每组排名前两位的队伍晋级淘汰赛，继续争夺冠军。晋级队伍将在双败淘汰赛中继续交锋。本站还将在冠亚军决赛中引入“不朽护甲”机制，即在双败淘汰赛中全胜晋级的胜者组冠军，将在总决赛对阵败者组冠军时获得额外一次反击并争夺冠军的机会。
根据赛程预告，在首日比赛中，蒙古国战队MIO AHP与韩国战队Zero Gravity将打响揭幕战；中国战队GZG将迎战日本战队Tokyo Cinnamon，中国战队DFYG将对阵韩国战队Zero Gravity。本届MCT EA乌兰巴托站冠军战队将获得M8正赛资格，第二、三名将获得M8外卡资格。
沐瞳东亚电竞负责人表示：“我们期待通过MCT EA，让东亚不同赛区的优秀选手在同一个舞台上交流、竞争，在高水平对抗中共同成长。乌兰巴托站既是六支战队争夺冠军的赛事，也是连接各地选手与玩家、展示不同赛区竞技风格的机会。我们希望以区域赛事为纽带，加强东亚赛区与决胜巅峰全球电竞生态的连接，帮助更多东亚队伍积累国际比赛经验，为走向更广阔的国际舞台创造条件，也让更多观众了解东亚选手与战队，感受决胜巅峰电竞的魅力。希望六支战队都能打出自己的风格，为观众呈现精彩的比赛。期待与大家相聚乌兰巴托，共同见证冠军诞生。”

title: SCS 2026年度总决赛落幕 选手MadkoF、XiaoHai分获《拳皇15》《饿狼传说：群狼之城》冠军
text:
2026年10月16日至18日，由株式会社SNK主办的“SNK冠军系列赛（SCS）”2026年度总决赛在成都举行。选手MadkoF获得《拳皇15》项目年度总冠军，Falcons | XiaoHai获《饿狼传说：群狼之城》年度总冠军。
10月17日，《拳皇15》项目BO7冠军赛由胜者组选手Chawan（角色“真吾、拉蒙、阿修”）对阵败者组选手MadkoF（角色“暴龙王、娜吉德、高尼茨”）。MadkoF在首局失利的情况下连扳4分，将比赛拖入RESET阶段。此后他保持高涨士气，最终以4:1大比分优势击败对手，成为本届SCS《拳皇15》年度总冠军。选手Chawan、Pineapple、碎碎分别获亚军、季军、殿军。
次日进行的《饿狼传说：群狼之城》冠军赛中，选手XiaoHai凭借角色“空手先生”的卓越发挥，以比分4:0零封对手DFM | PWS | GO1，成功卫冕，将年度总冠军奖杯与30万元奖金收入囊中。选手GO1、fffff、AG | 8BitDo | Vxbao分别获得亚军、季军、殿军。
根据最终赛果，现场揭晓了SWC 2026直通资格归属：选手Chawan、碎碎获得《拳皇15》项目直通，选手fffff、Vxbao获得《饿狼传说：群狼之城》项目直通。他们将与其他已晋级的选手一起，于11月份前往瑞典参加SWC 2026全球年度总决赛，在更大的国际赛场上检验实力。
本届SCS年度总决赛汇聚了24位来自中国、日本、韩国的顶尖格斗选手。为期三天的赛程中，他们为观众共同献上了多场酣畅淋漓的高水平比赛，现场氛围紧张火热。
赛场之外，还为观众呈现了四川变脸等舞台表演，并设有SNK多款热门游戏试玩、复古街机体验以及Coser合影等互动项目。
至此，SCS 2026年度总决赛已圆满结束。期待明年再见！

title: 从能生成到能交付：LAP拉普重构游戏资产工业化管线
text:
10月14日，2026亚马逊云科技游戏与泛娱乐行业峰会在深圳举行。「LAP拉普」智能游戏资产平台在现场分享游戏行业的AIGC美术资产生产工业化解决方案。
当今，AI已经显著提高内容生成效率。对游戏研发团队而言，生成结果距离真正进入生产，仍需经过格式适配、资产加工、多人协作和引擎接入等环节。资产能否沿既有管线继续流转，团队经验能否被反复调用，生产成本能否被清晰管理，决定了AI能否成为稳定的企业级生产力。
LAP产品负责人的分享以 《跨越“单点生成”的玩具时代：AI驱动的游戏资产工业化管线重构》 为题，将大会的关注点引到AI生成之后：一张图如何继续进入资产加工、团队协作与游戏引擎，最终成为能够投入项目的游戏资产？
依托工作流画布、智能画布、Agent和企业级治理能力，LAP正在把分散的AI工具重新组织为一条能够进入实际游戏资产生产的完整管线。
LAP持续招募内测伙伴，前往官网报名有机会获取内测资格。
★ 官网： lap.ai
AI生成之后，游戏资产还要跨过三道生产关
游戏资产生产涉及多个工种、工具与标准。一张视觉效果出色的图片，如果无法适配项目规定的视角、材质、布线密度和文件格式，仍然难以进入后续生产。
不同环节之间也容易形成断点。概念设定完成后，资产还需进入3D制作、后处理、引擎适配等流程。每个环节都有自己的工具和操作方式，资产需要在不同软件之间传递，团队也要反复进行转换、确认和调整。
经验沉淀是另一项长期问题。主美的审美判断、项目风格标准和已经验证的制作方法，常常分散在个人经验和单次任务中。项目和人员发生变化后，团队仍需重新对齐。
针对这些问题，LAP产品负责人现场展示了 LAP如何将AI能力、生产工具、项目资产和团队协作放入同一套平台中，帮助游戏研发团队打通生成、加工、协作、管理和复用环节。
一张画布连接AI、DCC与引擎，让资产沿管线持续流转
现场分享中，LAP产品负责人介绍：LAP的「工作流画布」首先解决工具与工序之间的连接问题。在同一张画布上，团队可以串联多种AI应用、DCC工具和游戏引擎，并执行多任务并发。目前，画布可支持上万个节点和上百人在线协作，复杂工作流可以被组织、编辑和分享。
通过标准插件与API，LAP能够连接Maya、Blender、Unreal Engine、Unity等主流DCC软件与游戏引擎。画布中的图片、3D模型等资产可以进入DCC工具继续处理，DCC制作完成的内容也可以重新导入画布，形成双向流转。
已经跑通的制作流程可以封装为工作流，在团队内部分享和复用。项目风格、操作方法和工具组合获得了明确载体，个人经验也能沿着工作流继续沉淀。
「智能画布」进一步改变人与AI的交互方式。使用者可以在画布上放置文字、草图和参考图，并通过涂画、圈选和批注表达修改要求。AI读取这些视觉信息后，直接完成局部调整和内容生成。对于监修者而言，修改意见可以直接标注在画面上。对于创作者而言，已经验证的制作思路可以打组分享，供团队成员继续调用。
「Agent」则负责理解更完整的自然语言任务，并将任务拆解为具体工作流。它能够识别画布中的内容和结构，创建或修改工作流，并根据使用反馈逐步学习偏好。Agent执行任务时，中间节点仍会呈现在画布上。使用者可以查看、编辑和调整每个环节，对过程与结果保留控制权。
工作流画布、智能画布与Agent将管线连接起来，视觉修改能够直接落在内容上，复杂任务也可以通过自然语言启动，同时保持全程可见、可改。
腾讯游戏生态真实项目验证，让LAP更懂游戏资产生产
LAP长期适配游戏资产生产场景，相关能力已在腾讯游戏生态下多款亿级DAU产品中得到验证。 目前，平台的多模态生成能力已经覆盖图像、3D与音视频，并持续向动作、特效等维度拓展。围绕不同团队的使用需求，LAP同时集成外部SaaS应用、自研应用和项目定制应用。
外部SaaS应用帮助团队统一使用市面主流AI工具，减少重复采购和账号切换。自研应用聚焦游戏美术需求，提升工具与实际创作场景的适配度。项目定制应用则围绕特定IP风格进行训练和配置，使生成结果更贴近项目要求。
真实项目持续向平台提出具体需求：下游需要什么格式，哪些环节容易返工，项目风格如何保持一致，不同角色如何围绕同一份资产协作。LAP的功能也在解决这些问题的过程中不断完善。
长期记忆帮助Agent记录使用偏好和历史任务，减少重复交互。知识图谱联想则调用与当前任务相关的知识，并结合模型能力、参数和游戏资产制作经验进行任务拆解。
企业级AI生产，需要协作、管理与追溯
企业级游戏资产生产流程需要的不只是内容生成能力，还包括资产管理、多人协作、合规与成本控制。
围绕资产管理，LAP提供云端统一存储、标签检索和多版本控制，帮助团队集中管理项目资产。在线协作能力支持多角色同屏编辑、实时评审标注和工作流分发，让原本串行推进的生产环节具备并行协作的条件。
围绕AIGC版权与合规需求，LAP后续将提供「光链」能力，记录内容从生成到成片的提示词和修改轨迹，并提供原创性核验、侵权风险预检和存证支持。
围绕算力与预算管理，「光点」提供实时用量看板、项目级预算管理、资源配额和消耗预警，帮助企业看清AI资源投入和成本流向。
从创作到生产，从个人使用到团队协作，再到企业治理，LAP希望让AI沿着真实游戏研发流程持续发挥作用。
面向更多游戏研发团队，LAP持续招募内测伙伴
从AI应用积累到工作流画布、智能画布与Agent逐步完善，LAP已经形成覆盖内容生成、生产协作、资产管理、DCC与引擎联通及企业级治理的能力体系。LAP将在后续版本中完善能力。此次亮相2026亚马逊云科技游戏与泛娱乐行业峰会，LAP希望让更多行业伙伴了解AI进入游戏资产核心生产流程的具体方式。
欢迎扫码添加LAP小助理，有机会进入内测社群，获取产品资料及后续活动信息。

title: 月收入超3300万，这款上海厂商的二合游戏海外爆了
text:
月收入超3300万，这款上海厂商的二合游戏海外爆了
游戏新知君
2026-10-19 18:42 发布于 湖北 游戏新知官方账号
关注
问AI  ·  深度绑定社交平台如何带动游戏高收入？
最近，国内厂商在海外上线的《Hollywood Merge》 （好莱坞合成：星梦逆袭） 取得了不错的海外成绩。
根据AppMagic数据，这款游戏最近 一个月 的收入额超过了500万美元，折合人民币超3300万元。 单在Google Play平台的下载量已经超过了500万次。
AppMagic数据
GooglePlay数据
通过社交平台更是能看出 该游戏热度不俗 。 Instagram和Facebook的两个官方账号 的 粉丝数量 均超过40万 。
Facebook官号 55万粉丝
Instagram官号 42.8万粉丝
《Hollywood Merge》是 VoyagerOne 在今年2月份上线海外的好莱坞题材 二合游戏 ，和一般二合游戏注重轻短快的体验稍有区别，游戏加入了包括集卡系统、服装挑战在内的众多 延伸玩法 。
值得一提的是，《Hollywood Merge》将游戏内容和社交平台做了深度绑定。在游戏内等级超过20级之后，玩家可以将社交平台账号与游戏账号绑定，并通过游戏官网加入 会员俱乐部 （即下图中的LOYALTY CLUB）赢取额外奖励。通过会员俱乐部的形式，游戏能让中度、重度玩家享受到更好的游戏体验，还能增强玩家对游戏的归属感。 游戏新知 推测，这是《Hollywood Merge》能吸引到众多玩家、取得高额收入的重要原因。

title: 《疯狂水世界》冲上畅销榜TOP20，游戏里居然能追AI短剧
text:
《疯狂水世界》冲上畅销榜TOP20，游戏里居然能追AI短剧
游戏新知君
2026-10-19 18:42 发布于 湖北 游戏新知官方账号
关注
问AI  ·  买量素材迭代如追剧怎样精准调控服务器生态？
题图 | 《疯狂水世界》买量素材
作者 | 夜风
近几个月来，大家估计或多或少都看到过这样一系列广告了：残破的避难所，刻薄的邻居或队友，受气的光头肥仔或者刺猬头少年；最后无论如何，主角都会一边大喊「我这就去打捞海水净化器」，一边扑通跳进水里，划着破船/开着烂载具离开。
该图片疑似使用了AI生成技术，请谨慎甄别
这些买量素材背后的游戏，是益世界的《疯狂水世界》。这款游戏上线已快一年， 最近却在各个榜单出现冲榜之势 。 iOS游戏畅销榜最高已上升至17名 ，而且仍在继续上升；微信小游戏畅销榜维持在TOP10，同时人气榜一路升至TOP20。
来自七麦数据
来自引力引擎
相对于这样一款画风「抽象」的模拟经营+ SLG 产品来说，这么高的上限还是蛮出人意料的。
而且，游戏上月开始上线了海外市场，一个月过去居然也已经闯出不小的名堂了。繁中市场效果最好，能稳定在iOS游戏畅销榜TOP15；日本、韩国和东南亚市场都处于稳定的上升趋势，目前 韩国iOS游戏畅销榜最高达到15名 、日本最高达到51名，东南亚市场以马来西亚为例，已达到29名。曲线的走势显示出，它还没触及上限。
图为韩国iOS畅销榜排名
这一方面要归因于游戏在玩法融合上做得比较丝滑，SLG部分的门槛放得非常低，很可能吸纳了不少未接触过SLG的潜在用户。另一方面，在AI工具成熟、AI短剧爆发的这个时期，这款游戏经历的品牌营销思路的变化过程，从「硬核生存XX天」一步步走到「海水净化器已经过时了」，还真挺值得说道说道。
碎片时间大杀器
《疯狂水世界》的玩法融合思路，与益世界的上一个产品《这城有良田》类似，都是从模拟经营平滑过渡至SLG。不过时隔三年，市场环境变化不少，游戏在玩法释出节奏、产品定位、新手引导上也都随之变化，最终成为一款 相当适合消磨碎片时间的「 轻量化 SLG」 。
游戏采用在洪水末日里求生的题材，不仅要生产各种物资和日用品，满足居民生存需求，还需要面对自然灾害、海盗、其他幸存者势力等外部威胁。前者正好对应模拟经营的部分，后者则对应 PvE 副本、 GvG 的部分。
在具体玩法节奏上，游戏将模拟经营的物资分配环节卡得比较严丝合缝，但相应地不怎么在PvE数值上为难玩家。 这导致游戏的单机部分自然形成了比较适合挂机的操作体验。
关于物资分配，传统的模拟经营逻辑是这样的：用基础物资制造低级物资→用低级物资制造高级物资和更高级的物资→拿各种物资去满足订单需求→通过订单奖励提升等级→解锁和升级更多生产建筑，这是模拟经营玩法的基础循环。
《疯狂水世界》也大体遵循这个逻辑。可完成的订单除了居民的需求，还有批量的货运订单。前者可以随时刷新，奖励主要是经验和基础养成资源；后者则需要数个小时来刷新，但可以获得英雄碎片、稀有养成资源等更多奖励。
特别的是，游戏在将各个级别、各个品类的物资生产时间分配得差距较大，而且分布比较均匀——有几十秒就能完成的，也有需要几分钟的，也有需要大几十分钟的。在每个生产建筑的排队栏位数量一致的情况下，这就导致不同生产建筑完成生产的时间可能相差很大。
游戏还将英雄派驻功能的影响放大了不少，来将模拟经营部分的成长体验与数值部分建立强关联。有强力英雄派驻时，物资的生产时间可以缩短不少，一些低级的物资甚至可以实现秒产。不过英雄派驻是按照固定秒数而非百分比来缩短生产时间的，这就导致玩家不断解锁更高级的物资之后，仍然要面对参差不齐的生产时间。
结果对于玩家来说，想找一个每天上线收菜的固定时间变得很困难，还不如将碎片时间利用起来，随时挂在手边、挂在电脑边，得空就随手点点。
为此，游戏专门想了不少点子来提升挂机体验。
在家园主界面，游戏特意设计成了没有任何背景音乐的样子，只有存在感比较低的海浪白噪音。游戏挂在旁边即便开着声音，也丝毫不会觉得吵，反而还挺解压的。
因为参差不齐的生产时间设计，游戏过程中也会比较频繁地遇到「有关键产品还差一两分钟完成」的情况，干等着也不是，暂退游戏干点别的也不是。针对这种情况，游戏在基础物资的生产环节里加入了钓鱼和潜水两个小游戏。它们都不会影响正常的物资生产，但玩了就有些额外的乐趣和收集奖励。
钓鱼小游戏可以手动进行简单操作，也可以挂机自动进行。这个小游戏自带一个钓鱼图鉴系统，积累图鉴到达一定进度可以获得不少游戏资源奖励。
潜水小游戏则有了点搜+撤的意思 （没有打） 。玩家需要操控人物在被海淹没的废弃大楼里面探索，收集各种物资，直到氧气耗尽。比较特别的是，一层层的房间里会时不时出现保险箱，开启保险箱除了能获得物资，还有概率开出收藏品或其碎片，而收藏品可以永久提升战力。
这样一来，每次遇到这种需要短时间等待的情况时，玩家就可以根据自己的需求，随手点开这些小游戏来一把。既能消磨时间，又能无痛赚点奖励。
更有意思的是，游戏甚至将自己IP的AI短剧和AI漫剧也塞进来了，总共多达65集。如果想在游戏里消磨等待时间，真有的是方法。
此外，不习惯在线挂机和频繁上线的玩家，则可以选用付费永久解锁的自动生产功能，或者也可以花费一定游戏货币来租用该功能。这个功能对于模拟经营玩法来说还是挺有必要的，有利于让那些希望全自动托管的玩家实现付费破冰。另外，根据早些时候的玩家和媒体评测，游戏的早期版本还是「免费自动生产存在时间上限，付费可提升该上限」的设计。
在卡牌战斗部分，游戏采用的是 放置挂机 游戏的那套逻辑：更高的高稀有度卡牌爆率，更多的抽卡资源投放 （玩家每天白嫖2~3个十连不成问题） ，更大的叠卡养成空间，至少数百个可以完全放置自动推关的PvE关卡，随着关卡进度提升的挂机收益。
落实到玩家的操作感受上，就是每天能薅到各种各样的资源，不断投入到数值提升中，然后只要挂机即可增加资源获取，简简单单就能收获稳定的满足感。这与模拟经营部分的核心体验是比较一致的。
至于向联盟玩法过渡的部分，游戏将体验控制得循序渐进，对没接触过SLG的新手比较友好。
尤其在社交方面，游戏尽量避免强迫玩家主动社交，从而避免给玩家带来额外的心理压力。从进联盟开始，游戏就不是让玩家自选一个盟加入，而是直接给等级和战力达标的玩家随机分配了一个盟。盟主则是在一定时间之后由盟内战力最高者自动担任的。联盟加入和组建成形的整个过程，都不需要玩家额外消耗注意力。
游戏还专门调整了联盟中各部分玩法的放出节奏。玩家最先能接触到的是各种福利，一是各种各样的全盟共享礼包，二是模拟经营中急缺的产品可以向盟友求助，能一口气省下不少发育时间。其中就算乍看需要社交的求助功能，也有专门的页面来汇总，实际上无需交流就能一键完成。
玩家第二个接触到的是大世界的PvE战斗。游戏采用类似 COK 的大世界设计，这部分的资源产出与模拟经营、战力养成等玩法密切相关，可以提供后二者非常稀缺的各种资源装备，因此也比较容易理解。
至于PvP部分，由于开服的分配机制自动将四个盟分散在了地图的四个角落，玩家最开始是无需考虑PvP争抢资源的，只能感受到盟友之间的互助互惠、协同发展。等到数日的发育期之后，盟与盟之间才可能发生领地碰撞，并随之发生PvP战斗。等到那时，盟友们早已熟悉了发育机制，也早已结成一定的感情基础了，对于GvG逻辑更容易接受。
值得一提的是，游戏每日的 城战 时间固定在晚8点~晚9点，仅有一个小时。这个城战负担也比大部分SLG都要轻许多，相对更接近游戏主打挂机体验的定位。
结果从玩家操作角度来说，这些联盟里新增的玩法和功能，几乎就像是额外订单、额外PvE关卡，仅需要每次上线收菜时额外点点，不怎么需要主动与其他玩家交流。整个联盟玩法对于SLG新手玩家、社恐玩家都比较友好，既容易理解，也容易接受，又不需要额外投入太多精力，因此这些潜在用户的过渡会格外顺畅。
当然，要在联盟乃至全服之间实现这样精准的发育进度控制，就意味着游戏必须至少每天都有新增服务器。如此大规模的、稳定的新用户流入，必然要靠足够大规模的、稳定的 买量投放 。
把买量素材搞成追剧了
如果大家被大数据精准命中，在过去的好几个月里经常刷到《疯狂水世界》的广告，或许能回忆起它的故事和风格是发生过变化的。至少最近，海水过滤器 （或海水净化器） 已经过时了，最新的版本之子是电鳗发电机 （也有的叫海鳗发电机） 。
通过不断调整产品定位、研究目标用户，这款游戏用了半年多时间，将买量素材多次迭代，最终形成了一种堪比追剧的神奇效果。这招还真有用，「小胖终于捞到海水过滤器」的视频尽管时长只有31秒，在B站竟也有快27万次播放了。买量素材的光辉时刻了属于是。
视频评论区，跟着玩梗的玩家也不少。可能是看多了看出感情了，这个小胖子已经快成了某种电子宠物了。
买量素材像个故事一样不断变化，其实也能反应出这款游戏营销策略的调整过程、服务器生态的建立过程，以及它所找到的最接近潜在用户兴趣的新风向。
它的微信小游戏版本从去年底开始投放，今年3月开始提升投放力度；APP版本则是4月才开始正式投放。
来自DataEye
在最早期试水的时候，素材都比较偏重末日求生、避难所建设的主题，重点是展示 末日求生题材和模拟经营玩法 ，针对的目标群体也是对这些标签感兴趣的独立游戏玩家。要么表现水淹世界、幸存者艰难在水面上漂流求生，要么展示避难所建设的成果，即各种可攻可守的移动水上堡垒。AI工具在表现这种末日大场面、重型机械时，效果还是挺壮观的。
从4月各个渠道加大投放开始，素材中比较经典的战力对比类素材开始增加，主要是为了 突出玩法中PvP的部分，以及抽卡的随机性爽感 ，目标群体增加了数值类强竞争游戏的爱好者。为了强调战力比拼的激烈，这些素材往往用各种特权、霸凌之类的狗血夸张剧情来烘托氛围。游戏也是在这时开始建立了海水过滤器>尿液过滤器、主角总是要跳进海里等品牌符号。
该图片疑似使用了AI生成技术，请谨慎甄别
从6月开始，素材中增加了一些 强调休闲护肝、丰厚福利 的类型。在先前已经建立的偏硬核生存、偏战力PvP的印象的基础上，这批素材又往回收了一些，加强了对偏轻度挂机养老玩家和零氪微氪玩家的吸引力。
与此同时，之前的一些狗血剧情素材也在悄然进化，不仅迎合世界杯而有了足球题材，也开始有了「你看，他又跳了」这样对品牌刻板印象进行自我吐槽的台词，让素材多少有了新鲜感。
7~8月是游戏加大推广力度的一段时期，主力素材又回到了以战力比拼狗血剧情为主，并丰富了具体剧情，除了破烂廉租房、墙头草小美之外，还多了天价彩礼、扶弟魔父母、坑人切糕等紧跟时事话题的剧本，小胖被霸凌的方式更加花样百出了。
该图片疑似使用了AI生成技术，请谨慎甄别
尤其是8月，品牌知名度已经铺开得差不多之后，游戏开始做 提升品牌形象、召回第一批流失用户 的工作。配合游戏内的「夏日狂浪节」系列活动， 游戏请来了明星陈小春代言，还取得了明星向佐、知名导演王晶的形象授权来做AI真人广告 ，在代言人选择上继续强化游戏的数值爽感和画风抽象搞怪的特点。
游戏还请了一些KOL来进一步扩大品牌影响力，包括请快手游戏主播阿乐直播进行荒野生存挑战、请知名coser兔娘复刻经典狗血剧情。路人观众对于这种玩梗整活联动也挺喜闻乐见的。
从游戏的iOS畅销榜排名变动趋势来看，8月正是游戏从80~50名区间跃升至40~20名区间的开始，说明这套品牌营销组合拳还是非常见效的。
9月到现在，最新的买量素材则着重于 强调赛季更新、版本环境发生变化 ，从而吸引回流——这才有了小胖的青春结束了、电鳗发电机>海水过滤器等新梗。同时，强调联盟社交、盟友互助、GvG生态的素材也多了起来，具体包括给老板擦鞋也要分等级、小胖和刺猬头少年一起组队去打捞电鳗发电机等等。这些素材重视从数值、社交两方面展示赛季生态，显然更针对深度SLG玩家。
通过迅速迭代买量素材，游戏不仅打造了一种追AI短剧般的营销效果，还能实时控制服务器生态的发展，针对性地吸引不同属性的玩家来充实游戏社群。可以想象的是，如此高的素材产出和迭代效率，背后是AI工具大规模应用于素材生产过程的结果。
结语
从玩法结构设计到买量策略，《疯狂水世界》基于市场需求和AI技术的新变化，形成了一套完整的运营体系。这背后，对用户的精细调研、对数值体系的精确把控必不可少。有意思的是，这二者也往往是AI比较擅长的方向。
AI工具大规模介入游戏研发和运营之后，游戏形态将发生怎样的变化？对于这类聚焦小成本、轻度挂机、重视长线重度发展的玩法融合游戏，《疯狂水世界》用接近一年的时间，摸索出了一个更前沿的答案。游戏要想走得更远，估计还要一直考验买量素材追逐热梗的能力。
